glossary_metadata.name: xbrl-us-gaap
glossary_metadata.description: US GAAP XBRL Taxonomy - authoritative financial reporting concepts

terms.definition: A specific financial metric tag from an XBRL taxonomy (e.g., us-gaap:Revenues, us-gaap:Assets). Each concept has a standardized name, human-readable label, and formal definition from the taxonomy authority.

A company's reporting period, identified by fiscal year and period type (FY = full year, Q1-Q4 = quarters). Each company has its own fiscal calendar — fiscal years may not align with calendar years (e.g., Apple's fiscal year ends September 30).

A structured classification system that defines financial reporting concepts and their relationships. The primary taxonomy is us-gaap (US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles). Others include dei (Document and Entity Information) and ifrs-full (International Financial Reporting Standards).

A category of financial reporting. The five categories used in this pipeline: Balance Sheet (assets, liabilities, equity), Income Statement (revenue, expenses, profit), Cash Flow (operating, investing, financing), Per-Share (EPS, dividends), and Other (comprehensive income, retained earnings).

Total revenue recognized from the sale of goods and services, before deductions. The top line of the income statement. Multiple XBRL concepts map to this CDE (Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueNet, etc.).
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Total profit after all expenses, interest, and taxes. The bottom line of the income statement.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Sum of all current and non-current assets reported on the balance sheet.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Sum of all current and non-current liabilities reported on the balance sheet.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Total equity attributable to shareholders, including common stock, APIC, retained earnings, and AOCI.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Cash on hand and short-term, highly liquid investments readily convertible to known cash amounts.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Amounts owed to the company by customers for goods or services delivered, net of allowances.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Goods available for sale or in production, including raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Tangible long-lived assets used in operations, net of accumulated depreciation.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Excess of purchase price over fair value of net identifiable assets acquired in a business combination.
terms.cde_rationale: Core balance sheet metric critical for financial health assessment and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Direct costs attributable to the production of goods and services sold.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Revenue minus cost of revenue. Measures production efficiency.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Profit from core business operations, after operating expenses but before interest and taxes.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Total income tax expense (benefit) recognized for the period.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Costs incurred for research and development activities.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Operating expenses for selling, general, and administrative activities.
terms.cde_rationale: Core income statement metric critical for profitability analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Net cash provided by or used in operating activities.
terms.cde_rationale: Core cash flow metric critical for liquidity analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Net cash provided by or used in investing activities.
terms.cde_rationale: Core cash flow metric critical for liquidity analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Net cash provided by or used in financing activities.
terms.cde_rationale: Core cash flow metric critical for liquidity analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Payments to acquire property, plant, and equipment.
terms.cde_rationale: Core cash flow metric critical for liquidity analysis and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Net income divided by weighted average basic shares outstanding.
terms.cde_rationale: Core per-share metric critical for investor valuation and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Net income divided by weighted average diluted shares outstanding.
terms.cde_rationale: Core per-share metric critical for investor valuation and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Cash dividends declared per common share.
terms.cde_rationale: Core per-share metric critical for investor valuation and cross-company comparison.

terms.definition: Net income plus other comprehensive income items (unrealized gains/losses, foreign currency adjustments).
terms.cde_rationale: Core financial metric critical for comprehensive financial analysis.

terms.definition: Cumulative net income retained in the business, not distributed as dividends.
terms.cde_rationale: Core financial metric critical for comprehensive financial analysis.
